limitations.note: The agent fixed the counter by clocking it, but also removed the existing `ready_b` condition from the accumulator reload, so the first accepted input of a group replaces the previous sum when the reference would add to it.

The scoreboard assumed every group starts from zero and checked `data_out` only when `valid_b` was asserted, so it exercised backpressure without checking the original `ready_b`-dependent accumulation behavior.
